scope: Publish exact source/results bytes with bounded, reconstructible byte chunks.

summary.scope: Publish closed egg contact, refinement-coverage and complete ordering comparisons.

complete_CAD30720_state_and_field_equiva.scope: Compare all saved paired-reference arrays and full stress fields without a new solve.
complete_CAD30720_state_and_field_equiva.limitations: Complete saved histories are compared at identical physical inputs and byte-identical geometry/initializer. Independent force-audit results are checked and retained, not reassembled in this field comparison. This proves numerical equivalence only for these saved states; it establishes neither physical convergence nor a controlled timing improvement or warmed production cost.

independent_refinement_coverage.scope: Locate independently audited contact samples relative to fixed numerical refinement caps.
independent_refinement_coverage.limitations: Reference contact-sample positions are mapped to the same angular parameter used for numerical mesh marking; this is not a geodesic distance or resolved physical contact boundary. Unsigned sample-force norms avoid cancellation of opposing jaws and are not a traction-area integral. Incident trace edges are measured in the undeformed collision discretization. Samples outside caps reveal coverage gaps; samples inside caps do not exclude missed contact caused by coarse geometry elsewhere. No stress smoothing, force/geometry modification, convergence acceptance or original goal completion follows.

fixed_polyhedron_four_level_fields.scope: Compare independent final fields on the unchanged egg polyhedron across paired surface refinements.
fixed_polyhedron_four_level_fields.limitations: One common physical time on an unchanged coarse polyhedral material domain. The paired meshes preserve the actual seed boundary, geometry/mass and original physical inputs; common physical probes and independently reconstructed force gates remain explicit. Surface and volume/contact resolution vary together on this branch, so this is not a separated bulk or contact-integration error. Raw maxima are unsmoothed whole-volume bounds. CAD geometry is a separate family and is excluded. These fields do not establish complete application/history, converged physical contact, model/feedback accuracy or verified warmed cost.

corrected_geometry_summaries.scope: Refine conforming paired egg surfaces near fixed CAD contact anchors with unchanged shell parameters.
corrected_geometry_summaries.limitations: Surface bisection and radial projection generate conforming CAD approximations; paired polyhedron vertices use identical midpoint prolongation without projection. Mesh marking anchors/radius are numerical choices and do not constrain collision locations or change any physical contact footprint, law or force. Global CAD approximation outside marked caps remains at its seed level. Geometry and represented mass change explicitly at fixed density; two thickness layers remain. All six original physical initializer points are retained. Geometry identity and small local elements do not establish stress/contact convergence, model/feedback accuracy, complete application/history or warmed cost.

limitations: The first two small-cap adaptive cases place every actual active sample outside their refinement caps; their near-equal raw peaks do not establish convergence. Corrected geometry adds independently audited contact positions and force-normal support directions but does not certify future contact coverage. New actual contact jobs are scheduled only. Four fixed-polyhedron levels retain large stress/energy changes. All saved30720-tet baseline/candidate arrays and complete corner/quadrature fields agree within unchanged budgets, with separate all-state physical force audits; this is numerical equivalence, not physical convergence or controlled performance. Full original physical/contact/geometry/thickness/history/model/feedback and physically verified warmed-cost requirements remain open. Files of at least50MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original file exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
